ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of a high‑energy show with a standout Truckin' ending featuring a Here Comes Sunshine riff.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about the performance, calling it a truly great Dead show filled with many favorite songs and noting the fantastic sound quality. The matrix source captures clear, balanced audio, highlighted by the memorable little Here Comes Sunshine riff at the end of Truckin'.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the recording quality, indicating a top‑tier show with excellent matrix sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as great, fantastic, and very pleasing with no reported issues; the matrix mix balances board clarity with audience ambience.

standout_songs: Truckin' (ending with a Here Comes Sunshine riff)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A varied set packed with many fan‑favorite numbers that keeps the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Riff at end of Truckin' (Here Comes Sunshine) noted, implying strong guitar work.
